As the golden sun sets over the horizon, immerse yourself in the beauty of picturesque sunsets, while enjoying the gentle bay breezes and the tranquility

includes: Cruise aboard The Captain Lou Fleet's 2-level 100ft boats
blurb: Guests can join 2-hour sunset cruises through Baldwin Harbor, Mansion Harbor, Randall Bay, and Parsonage Cove aboard The Captain Lou Fleet's 2-level 100ft boats. Cruises include a cash bar, DJ, and dancing. Doggie Sunset Cruises allow guests to bring leashed dogs free of charge aboard the Starstream VIII.
extraNote: All cruises must be booked in advance; no guarantee of boarding without reservation · No refunds or transfers on tickets; tickets can be resold by guest · Captain decides trip cancellations due to weather; refunds only if operator cancels · Group discount $5 off per ticket for groups of 10 or more, not combinable with other discounts · 31 Woodcleft Ave, Freeport, NY 11520 · spring through fall
